MWCoop - 3D models of the items added by the mod / Modeles 3D des objets ajoutes par le mod

All models below are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
Licence checked on each Sketchfab page on 2026-11-07 (CC Attribution, no NC/ND).
Changes made for the mod: converted to the game, rescaled, reoriented, reduced (fewer triangles), smaller textures,
flat-colour parts merged; the shop's own labels and screens added on top.
Tous les modeles ci-dessous sont sous licence Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0). Modifications pour le mod :
conversion, echelle, orientation, reduction, textures reduites, couleurs unies regroupees ; etiquettes et ecrans du mod ajoutes.
